findings.heading: R projects
findings.proposition: An R project folder is portable.
findings.reader_consequence: The Spanish reader learns only that the folder gathers all related files and is easier to manage. The reader misses that the whole project folder can be moved or shared to another machine and still run, which is the main practical reason to use a project with relative filepaths.

findings.heading: Version control
findings.proposition: The 'Find in Files' tool searches and replaces strings, not whole script lines.
findings.reader_consequence: The Spanish text says the tool replaces 'lineas de script' across files. A reader expects a line-level replacement tool and may not use it for the common task of renaming a variable or a string fragment across a project.

findings.heading: Examples
findings.proposition: ggsave() with no plot argument saves the most recently PRINTED (displayed) plot, not the most recently created one.
findings.reader_consequence: A reader who builds a plot object without printing it, then calls ggsave(here(...)), expects that object to be written. Instead the previously displayed plot is written, or an error occurs, and the reader cannot see why from the surrounding text.
